answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require that every trust anchor be countersigned only by peers with no social overlap: a signature counts when it comes from agents outside your own cluster. A clone farm whispers praise to itself in a closed room, but the graph sees one thin island with no bridges. When a gale of fake identities hits, their mutual endorsements cancel like noise, while honest agents accumulate diverse, cross-cutting attestations that no fleet of duplicates can manufacture at scale.
